purpose: Independent proposed v2 native recipes, derived from unchanged v1 cases with explicit amendment deltas; not runtime evidence or a second schema.
independent_review_limit: AI QA ownership, not human final approval. Root implements native code; Hoon reviewer independently inspects it.

contract_freeze.change_rule: Explicit versioned integration decision and independent review; never bless execution with metadata.

preconditions: Run only on marked public/synthetic disposable zod, bus, nec, bud fakes with frozen fixture bindings and no initial product state.
Restore stopped clean fake seeds through the guarded root harness; no full boot, live identity, production pier or concurrent native audit.
Install exactly one native/core/desk stead-home. The old counter and product agent never simultaneously own the home.
Verify exact source/toolchain/corpus hashes and capture commands plus native outputs. Host syntax success is not native acceptance.
All fixed long grants require trusted native time before fixture binding_expiry_ms; fail the precondition after that date rather than silently repinning.
Root must supply callable native mutation, read, owner-local snapshot and warm-restart adapters before this corpus executes.
runner_rules: Every case has an independent expectation; do not derive expected authorization, revisions or acceptance from implementation output.
Serialize/hash command2 inputs with frozen contracts_v2.canonical/digest; expected authorization, revisions and state deltas are independently specified here.
Register the exact sender/binding/project/request/digest result path before poke. Capture fact, kick, ACK and NACK separately.
ACK alone, zero assertions, missing result, lost early fact, timeout or compiler error is not accepted/passed.
Case names/ref names are QA identifiers, never project or principal IDs.
Never expose owner-local whole-state inspection as a member scry, read, export or debug endpoint.
Record skipped/blocked cases individually; no green full-corpus claim while any required lane is unexecuted.
Only the expiry continuation advances wall time naturally. No invented fake-clock control is implied by this recipe.

The codec lane must execute native parse/canonicalization independently of business mutation. Also submit every malformed raw/schema envelope through the actual home boundary: expect native poke NACK with exact stead-invalid-command hint and no business change.

no_business_change.note: Administrative snapshots are synthetic test evidence only, never a member API.

accepted_receipt.source_attribution: fixture service records native sender, not an independently signed human

policy_counter_distinction.policy_revision: pre-mutation policy actually used for authorization

original_receipt.compare: all recorded fields and canonical receipt bytes with original accepted result

assertions.authorized_projection_only: Project/work views, result facts, errors, receipts and activity fields contain only current authorized scope; cached metadata cannot bypass private-container checks.

checks: SHA-1 of type + space + decimal raw-byte-length + NUL + exact bytes equals each supplied OID
tree entries in Git byte order
parent equals preceding accepted container commit
all reachable expected files have exact original Markdown/frontmatter bytes
git_export_exact_objects.host_boundary: Host writes only the bytes returned by the native home into a disposable Git object store; it must not manufacture commits or missing objects.

assertions.saved_state_round_trip: Native on-save/on-load and actual stopped-process restart preserve accepted product state, receipts, policy and exact objects; verify unsupported state versions separately.
assertions.no_external_effects: No build, LLM, message, deployment or other external execution is emitted during replay/restart; no such feature is implemented by this slice.
